items.title: Pay disputed 'Gewinnspiel-Abonnement' debt-collection demand
items.quote: Überweisen Sie den Gesamtbetrag innerhalb von 72 Stunden, spätestens bis 06.08.2026, ausschließlich auf folgendes Treuhandkonto: IBAN LT71 7300 0101 2345 6789, Kontoinhaber: A. Petrauskas, Verwendungszweck EC-DE-2026-481120.
items.computation: The letter states an explicit calendar deadline of 06.08.2026 for payment of the total demanded amount (EUR 287.40), rather than a period to be calculated. 06.08.2026 is a Thursday, not a weekend day or NW public holiday, so no shift under §193 BGB is needed even if such rules applied to a private demand. Note: this appears to be a fraudulent/unfounded collection attempt (see warnings) — the deadline and payment instructions should not be trusted or acted upon without independent verification.

warnings: This letter shows multiple classic signs of a scam/fraudulent debt-collection ('Inkasso') scheme: an extremely short 72-hour payment deadline, threats of immediate 'Kontopfändung' (account seizure) and criminal prosecution with no court order or Vollstreckungstitel mentioned, and a demand to pay to a personal-name IBAN in Lithuania (A. Petrauskas) rather than a corporate account of a Cyprus-registered company for an alleged German debt.

The underlying claim is said to stem from a 'telefonisch abgeschlossenes Gewinnspiel-Abonnement' (a prize-draw subscription supposedly concluded by phone) — such telephone-sales contracts are frequently invalid or unenforceable under German consumer-protection law (§ 312a BGB and related rules on cold-calling), so the debt itself is questionable.

The line 'Ein Widerspruch ist zwecklos und verursacht weitere Kosten' (an objection is pointless and causes further costs) is a manipulative statement designed to discourage the recipient from exercising their legal right to dispute the claim; it does not reflect actual German law.

Genuine account seizure (Kontopfändung) in Germany requires a court judgment/enforcement title and a Gerichtsvollzieher — a private collection agency cannot lawfully seize a bank account merely by sending a letter, which strongly suggests this threat is fabricated.

Do not transfer any money to the IBAN provided; the person should independently verify this claim (e.g., via the Verbraucherzentrale or a lawyer) before taking any action, and should not treat the stated deadline as legally binding.
